findings: ChromeProcess::drop calls child.start_kill; launcher sets kill_on_drop(true).
on_connection_lost releases BrowserOwner::Local after publishing a disconnected state.
An already-running reachable managed endpoint is reused with BrowserOwner::None, so socai does not own or kill that Chrome.
v0.6.3 retains these lifecycle rules; an upgrade alone does not remove connection-owned process teardown.
causal_limit: Code explains why a socai-owned browser can disappear after a transport loss; it does not establish the original cause of the transport loss.
publication_note: Raw process inventory, local usernames, absolute personal paths and TCP rows omitted. Aggregate timings/counts and public note references retained.
